title: 第26章 陆穿事业运太强了
content_zh:
王忠磊最后还是出来了。

    拖了不少关系，这件事也算过去了。

    行政拘留了五天，罚款一百多万，原本的广告全部下架，并且公开道歉。

    “玛德，我感觉被谷川那小子坑了。”王忠磊说道：

    “当初就是那小子给我说的如何宣传，他还说千万不要那么做，我原以为他是矫情，原来是在撇清关系，他就是诱导着我去那么做的。”

    王忠磊脸色铁青。

    王忠军皱了皱眉，轻声说道：“反正事情已经过去了，别在意。”

    “怎么可能不在意？”王忠磊说道。

    他可是真的被拘留了五天啊。

    还有一百多万的罚款，这次甚至都有被吊销《电影发行经营许可证》的风险。

    好在谣言虽然传得广，但造成的大规模恐慌。

    王忠军说道：“现在不是没事了吗？记恨他做什么？”

    “哥！你什么意思？”王忠磊恼怒地说道：“是不是那小崽子跟你说什么了？”

    “没，我就是通了一个电话。”王忠军说道：“不过他的电影能赚钱，以后还可以继续合作的，没必要撕破脸。”

    这次的电影大赚。

    投资加上宣发甚至是这次的罚款，依旧赚得很多。

    这可是实打实的九千多万票房，宣传的时候都可以用‘票房破亿’了。

    除了老谋子的《英雄》，哪家民营电影公司，推出过票房破亿的电影？

    虽然被官方记住了，但正面效果更强。

    至于观众的恶感？

    那不重要。

    王忠磊说道：“可是那小子说，他这部新电影可能过不了审。”

    “你信他的话？”王忠军嗤笑一声。

    谷川满嘴胡话，他的话要是能信就有鬼了。

    王忠军说道：“我看他是不想用业内的投资，用的电影院之外的资金。”

    业内投资对电影比较懂，知道钱都花在了什么地方，不好做手脚。

    要是电影圈之外的人，那就好糊弄了。

    王忠磊想了想，有这个可能。

    “但他的投资都谈好了。”
content_en:
Wang Zhonglei finally came out.

    After dragging on a lot, this matter is over.

    He was detained administratively for five days, fined more than one million yuan, all original advertisements were removed from the shelves, and a public apology was issued.

    "Made, I feel like I was tricked by that guy Gu Chuan." Wang Zhonglei said:

    "That guy told me how to promote it at the beginning. He also said never to do that. I thought he was being pretentious, but it turned out he was trying to distance himself from the relationship. He was the one who induced me to do that."

    Wang Zhonglei's face was ashen.

    Wang Zhongjun frowned and said softly: "The matter is over anyway, don't worry about it."

    "How could you not care?" Wang Zhonglei said.

    He was really detained for five days.

    There is also a fine of more than one million yuan, and this time there is even the risk of having the "Film Distribution License" revoked.

    Fortunately, although the rumors spread widely, they caused massive panic.

    Wang Zhongjun said: "Isn't it okay now? Why do you hate him?"

    "Brother! What do you mean?" Wang Zhonglei said angrily: "Did that kid say something to you?"

    "No, I just had a phone call." Wang Zhongjun said: "But his movies can make money, and we can continue to cooperate in the future. There is no need to break up."

    This time the movie made a lot of money.

    With the investment, publicity and even the fine this time, I still made a lot of money.

    This is a real box office of more than 90 million yuan. When promoting, it can be said that the box office exceeds 100 million yuan.

    Apart from Lao Mouzi's "Hero", which private film company has released a movie with a box office of over 100 million?

    Although officially remembered, the positive effect is stronger.

    As for the audience’s dislike?

    That's not important.

    Wang Zhonglei said: "But that guy said that his new movie might not pass the review."

    "Do you believe what he says?" Wang Zhongjun sneered.

    Tanichuan is full of nonsense. If his words can be believed, there will be trouble.

    Wang Zhongjun said: "I think he doesn't want to use investment from the industry, but uses funds outside the cinema."

    Investors in the industry know a lot about movies and know where the money is spent, so it is difficult to manipulate them.

    If you are outside the film industry, it will be very confusing.

    Wang Zhonglei thought about it and realized it was possible.

    "But his investment has been negotiated."
title_en: Chapter 26 Lu Chuan’s career luck is too strong
